pahasana: [ pa + haṃsa + yu ] (thī, na) CL=7 (1) Smiling. Causes smiling. (Ti) (3) Caused to smile. (4) A joyful place.
pahasanavidhi: [ pahaṃsana + vidhi ] (pu) CL=7 The method of causing to smile.
pahasanti: [ pa + haṃsa + a + anti ] (kri) CL=7 They smile. See - Pahaṃsati.
pahasanākāla: [ pahaṃsana + ākāra ] (pu) CL=7 A period of happiness.
pahasanākāra: [ pahaṃsana + ākāra ] (pu) CL=7 The manner of happiness.
pahasayati: [ pa + haṃsa + ṇaya + ti ] (kā, kri) CL=7 He causes to smile.
pahasenta: [ pa + haṃsa + ṇe + anta ] (ti) CL=7 One who causes feeling fresh and cheerful
pahaseti: [ pa + haṃsa + ṇe + ti ] (kā, kri) CL=7 (He) causes to feel fresh and cheerful.
pahasetvāna: [ pa + haṃsa + ṇe + tvāna ] (bya) CL=7 Having caused feeling fresh and cheerful.
pahasi: [ pa + hana + ī ] (kri) CL=7 He rubbed or ground.
pahasitamukha: [ pahaṃsita + mukha. Thī၌ pahaṃsitamukhī ] (ti) CL=7 One who is with a smiling lip.
pahasitvā: [ pa + hana + tvā ] (bya) CL=7 Having rubbed and shinned.
pahasitvāna: [ pa + hana + tvāna ]  CL=9 Having rubbed- sharpened, having caused to shine- to be glad.
pahasu: [ pa + hā + uṃ ] (kri) CL=7 They were removed in different ways.
pahaṭakasathāla: [ pahaṭa + kaṃsathāla ] (na) CL=7 A copper cup that should strike.
pahaṭakasathālaka: [ pahaṭa + kaṃsathālaka ] (pu,na) CL=7 The copper cymbals that should strike.
pahisu: [ pa + hi + uuṃ ] (kri) CL=7 They sent.
pahānasavara: [ pahāna + saṃvara ] (pu) CL=7 (Viriya) that is a dhamma that blocks something that happens due to giving up or abandoning something.
pahātabbasayojana: [ pahātabba + saṃyojana ] (na) CL=7 A bond or an attachment that should be given up.
pahātu: [ pa + hā + tuṃ ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To give up.
